status: Reference-traced material candidate, not full pixel-level acceptance
coordinate_space: Original supplied JPEG pixels; EXIF screenshot/viewer UI and game content not part of the material. x/y fractions refer to the cropped card body. Crop bounds are exploratory manual anchors, not original-source layout metadata.

target_fold_fit.fit_method: Least-squares quadratic fitted to lower unobscured light-ridge samples in target JPEG crop; upper section extrapolated, not a measured exact path; +.004 horizontal compensation aligns the final summed-radiance peak, not just the curve center
target_fold_fit.image_measurement: Mean RGB scanlines, gaussian_filter1d sigma1.8px; max in x range .62..84; avoid text rows .30/.40 and outer right specular
target_fold_fit.not_proven: The source has scenery/tonemapping/compression; no claimed extraction of original shader or whole-image RGB match

counter_seam_fit.image_measurement: Mean RGB scanline sigma.65px minus sigma5px; local highpass maximum in .42..51; center text-obscured rows omitted
counter_seam_fit.fit_method: Least-squares sine fitted to six source-image seam positions; text-obscured middle excluded, not an original shader reconstruction

features.panel: Transmitting long column, milky top lip and concentrated upper-right return, weak interrupted rim, pink UI accents retained from086. No repeated HUD folds.
features.target: Smoked transmitting body, strong broad curved right fold, secondary reflection, near-vertical bright right line and detached lower-right quarter-arc
features.counter: Narrow central S-seam, soft left fold and detached lower-right quarter-arc
features.soft: Low-energy bottom fold for music/watermark/potions/other cards; no target fold/strong seam/exterior arc

transport.body_color: R=strength/2; G/B=neutral tint luminance; A=density. Not a visible RGB tint.
transport.fallback: No framebuffer: readable neutral CSS fill only, no claimed optical reconstruction

acceptance_limits: No current-game baseline per user choice reference_only
No original client shader, original font/layout or uncompressed source game capture
EGL samples do not validate game scheduling, Android drivers or full Gradle build
JPEG source trace tolerance measures narrow feature positions, NOT whole-image fidelity
